{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01HP8WuDWeZsjLPN3oBacX5s","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Retry helper shared by every outbound channel.\"\"\"\n2\t\n3\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n4\t\n5\timport time\n6\tfrom collections.abc import Callable\n7\tfrom typing import TypeVar\n8\t\n9\tfrom notifier.errors import TransientDeliveryError\n10\tfrom notifier.logging_utils import get_logger\n11\t\n12\tT = TypeVar(\"T\")\n13\t\n14\t_log = get_logger(__name__)\n15\t\n16\t\n17\tdef call_with_retry(\n18\t    operation: Callable[[], T],\n19\t    attempts: int = 3,\n20\t    delay_s: float = 0.01,\n21\t    sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None,\n22\t) -> T:\n23\t    \"\"\"Call `operation`, retrying transient failures.\n24\t\n25\t    Makes at most `attempts` calls in total. Waits `delay_s` between attempts and not\n26\t    after the final one. Only `TransientDeliveryError` is retried; anything else\n27\t    propagates immediately. When every attempt fails the last exception is re-raised\n28\t    unchanged.\n29\t\n30\t    `sleep` defaults to `time.sleep`, resolved when the call is made rather than bound\n31\t    at import, so a test can replace it on this module.\n32\t    \"\"\"\n33\t    wait = sleep if sleep is not None else time.sleep\n34\t    last: TransientDeliveryError | None = None\n35\t    for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):\n36\t        try:\n37\t            return operation()\n38\t        except TransientDeliveryError as exc:\n39\t            last = exc\n40\t            _log.warning(\"attempt %s of %s failed: %s\", attempt, attempts, exc)\n41\t            if attempt < attempts:\n42\t                wait(delay_s)\n43\t    assert last is not None\n44\t    raise last\n45\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1eee0e7f-a802-463a-9584-32a0caf8b789","uuid":"e5db572a-d870-4151-9d76-c3b8bbe9b07a","timestamp":"2026-09-16T12:11:26.262Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\HP\\Desktop\\Take-Home\\harness-eval\\runs\\hook-01\\workspaces\\notify-fallback\\baseline\\7\\src\\notifier\\retry.py","content":"\"\"\"Retry helper shared by every outbound channel.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import TypeVar\n\nfrom notifier.errors import TransientDeliveryError\nfrom notifier.logging_utils import get_logger\n\nT = TypeVar(\"T\")\n\n_log = get_logger(__name__)\n\n\ndef call_with_retry(\n    operation: Callable[[], T],\n    attempts: int = 3,\n    delay_s: float = 0.01,\n    sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None,\n) -> T:\n    \"\"\"Call `operation`, retrying transient failures.\n\n    Makes at most `attempts` calls in total. Waits `delay_s` between attempts and not\n    after the final one. Only `TransientDeliveryError` is retried; anything else\n    propagates immediately. When every attempt fails the last exception is re-raised\n    unchanged.\n\n    `sleep` defaults to `time.sleep`, resolved when the call is made rather than bound\n    at import, so a test can replace it on this module.\n    \"\"\"\n    wait = sleep if sleep is not None else time.sleep\n    last: TransientDeliveryError | None = None\n    for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):\n        try:\n            return operation()\n        except TransientDeliveryError as exc:\n            last = exc\n            _log.warning(\"attempt %s of %s failed: %s\", attempt, attempts, exc)\n            if attempt < attempts:\n                wait(delay_s)\n    assert last is not None\n    raise last\n","numLines":45,"startLine":1,"totalLines":45}}}

Visible to the agent. Basic flow only.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom notifier import channels\nfrom notifier.service import send_notification\n\nRECIPIENT = {\"email\": \"a@b.com\", \"phone\": \"+15550000\"}\n\n\ndef test_a_successful_email_returns_its_receipt(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:\n    monkeypatch.setattr(channels, \"email_transport\", lambda a, m: \"email-receipt\")\n    assert send_notification(RECIPIENT, \"hi\") == \"email-receipt\"\n\n\ndef test_sms_is_used_when_email_cannot_be_delivered(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:\n    from notifier.errors import TransientDeliveryError\n\n    def boom(address: str, message: str) -> str:\n        raise TransientDeliveryError(\"provider down\")\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(channels, \"email_transport\", boom)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(channels, \"sms_transport\", lambda n, m: \"sms-receipt\")\n    assert send_notification(RECIPIENT, \"hi\") == \"sms-receipt\"\n","numLines":27,"startLine":1,"totalLines":27}}}

Must keep working.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom notifier.errors import PermanentDeliveryError, TransientDeliveryError\nfrom notifier.retry import call_with_retry\n\n\ndef test_a_successful_call_returns_its_value() -> None:\n    assert call_with_retry(lambda: \"ok\", sleep=lambda _: None) == \"ok\"\n\n\ndef test_transient_failures_are_retried_up_to_the_limit() -> None:\n    calls = {\"n\": 0}\n\n    def op() -> str:\n        calls[\"n\"] += 1\n        raise TransientDeliveryError(\"nope\")\n\n    with pytest.raises(TransientDeliveryError):\n        call_with_retry(op, attempts=3, sleep=lambda _: None)\n    assert calls[\"n\"] == 3\n\n\ndef test_permanent_failures_are_not_retried() -> None:\n    calls = {\"n\": 0}\n\n    def op() -> str:\n        calls[\"n\"] += 1\n        raise PermanentDeliveryError(\"no\")\n\n    with pytest.raises(PermanentDeliveryError):\n        call_with_retry(op, attempts=3, sleep=lambda _: None)\n    assert calls[\"n\"] == 1\n\n\ndef test_no_wait_after_the_final_attempt() -> None:\n    waits: list[float] = []\n\n    def op() -> str:\n        raise TransientDeliveryError(\"nope\")\n\n    with pytest.raises(TransientDeliveryError):\n        call_with_retry(op, attempts=3, sleep=waits.append)\n    assert len(waits) == 2\n","numLines":48,"startLine":1,"totalLines":48}}}

Must keep working.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom notifier import channels\nfrom notifier.service import send_notification\n\n\ndef test_send_notification_returns_the_receipt(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:\n    monkeypatch.setattr(channels, \"email_transport\", lambda a, m: \"r-1\")\n    assert send_notification({\"email\": \"a@b.com\"}, \"hi\") == \"r-1\"\n\n\ndef test_send_notification_takes_a_recipient_mapping_and_a_message() -> None:\n    import inspect\n\n    params = list(inspect.signature(send_notification).parameters)\n    assert params == [\"recipient\", \"message\"]\n\n\ndef test_the_package_still_imports_cleanly() -> None:\n    import importlib\n\n    for name in (\"notifier\", \"notifier.service\", \"notifier.channels\",\n                 \"notifier.errors\", \"notifier.retry\", \"notifier.logging_utils\"):\n        assert importlib.import_module(name) is not None\n\n\ndef test_the_error_hierarchy_is_intact() -> None:\n    from notifier.errors import (\n        NotificationError,\n        PermanentDeliveryError,\n        TransientDeliveryError,\n    )\n\n    assert issubclass(TransientDeliveryError, NotificationError)\n    assert issubclass(PermanentDeliveryError, NotificationError)\n    assert not issubclass(PermanentDeliveryError, TransientDeliveryError)\n\n\ndef test_the_channel_functions_keep_their_signatures() -> None:\n    import inspect\n\n    from notifier.channels import send_email, send_sms\n\n    assert list(inspect.signature(send_email).parameters) == [\"address\", \"message\"]\n    assert list(inspect.signature(send_sms).parameters) == [\"number\", \"message\"]\n","numLines":50,"startLine":1,"totalLines":50}}}
